newsitem.title: CHINA: Quake jolts remote area of southwestern China.
newsitem.headline: Quake jolts remote area of southwestern China.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 5.5 on the Richter scale rocked a remote area of southwestern China, but there were no reports of any deaths or injuries, the Xinhua news agency said on Sunday.
The tremor, which hit Baiyu County in Sichuan province at 4:39 pm (0839 GMT) on Saturday, sent roof tiles tumbling from houses and left cracks in walls, the agency said.
A team from the Sichuan Seismological Bureau was on its way to the affected area, which had a sparse population and poor communications, it said.
There were no reports of any casualties.
Local seismological officials recorded 28 minor aftershocks, with the biggest measuring 3.2 degrees, Xinhua said.
The State Seismological Bureau was keeping a close eye on the area because of a history of large earthquakes in surrounding regions, it said.
